text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) had 
finally arrived.

Though nervous, Mejiro McQueen held her 
love for the Mejiro family close to her 
heart and vowed to give it everything she 
had.

Right before entering the track, Mejiro 
McQueen faces off against Mejiro Ryan.

As Umamusume of the Mejiro family, the two 
encouraged each other to give it their 
best.
